info.title: VitalSpan
info.description:
VitalSpan REST API. All business routes are under /api/v1/. Breaking changes bump major OpenAPI version.

Breaking API changes require a new major URL version (e.g. /api/v2/). Additive non-breaking changes remain on /api/v1/.
info.x-api-version-policy: Breaking API changes require a new major URL version (e.g. /api/v2/). Additive non-breaking changes remain on /api/v1/.
